name: Pine Cliffs Hotel
insider_take: Perched dramatically on ancient red cliffs overlooking the Atlantic, this Moorish-inspired retreat offers Portugal's most spectacular oceanfront setting.
whats_special: Pine Cliffs sits on 200 million-year-old sandstone cliffs and features Europe's only clifftop 9-hole golf course designed by Martin Hawtree. The resort's award-winning Annabel Croft Tennis Academy and direct beach access via a funicular elevator make it truly unique along the Algarve coast.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the clifftop restaurant - the dramatic views over Praia da Falésia beach are especially magical during golden hour, and you might spot dolphins playing in the waves below.
dont_miss: The resort's signature hole 6 on the golf course literally hangs over the ocean, while the 2,000-year-old Roman ruins at nearby Vilamoura offer fascinating historical context to this stunning stretch of coastline.
pros: Stunning clifftop location with dramatic Atlantic Ocean views
Award-winning championship golf course designed by Martin Hawtree
Direct private beach access via scenic cliff elevator
Comprehensive resort amenities including multiple pools and spa facilities
cons: Large resort scale may feel less intimate for some guests
